title: Phase C/D: corruption-aware calibration intervention (frozen 2026-09-24)
hypothesis: RetinaNet matched-INT8 corruption fragility is driven by clean-only calibration range mismatch; corrupting the calibration distribution in-family should recover held-out corruption AP without retraining.

estimands.primary: held_out_corr_mean AP of each intervention arm minus int8-matched512 / int8-selective512 respectively, paired image bootstrap B=2000, same seed namespace as Phase B
success_criteria: int8-corruptcalib512 held_out_corr_mean > int8-matched512 with CI95 excluding 0 => range-mismatch mechanism supported
int8-sel-corruptcalib512 held_out_corr_mean - fp8-matched512 CI95 includes 0 => VOC residual gap explained by calibration
estimands.negative_outcome: if CI95 includes 0 on the primary contrast, report as negative intervention; recipe-determinants result stands as the contribution

contamination_note: kitti_val is development-contaminated for the selective recipe; voc_val is the cleaner cross-dataset check.
